notes.title: v0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Map and Game Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049069/cf56dd52be60b4c0fa808f9cb17aca86a45bfa98.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New Map - Invasion, a large arena featuring a beach landing an a long battle for many points.
[*]New Game Mode - Invasion, the new map Invasion comes in the Invasion Game Mode which pits two teams against eachother, one defending their points against the other attacking.
[/list]
[h3]New Vehicles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Jeeps - People carriers. Kubelwagen for the Reds, Jeeps for the Blues. One driver and three passengers in each. Hit the Left Mouse Button to beep the horn.
[*]Planes - Me 109 and Spitfire for Red and Blue respectively. One pilot, fly around and gun things down with your cannons.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes and Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the volume of vehicle audio, it was a tad too quiet.
[*]Implemented a fix for jittery movement of other players.
[*]New method of doing Vehicle passengers, turret gunners for Tanks and passive guys for Jeeps.
[*]More streamlined map selection process in the Lobby menu.
[*]Moved Camera to over the shoulder.
[/list]

notes.title: DevLog Fri 28 Jun 24
notes.content:
This first week after release, we've been working hard on bringing in features that are promised. Particularly we are working on having a big new map, and fixing bugs.

Some major bugs we noticed are that movement can be jittery when hosting across different networks, and that vehicles are far too quiet. In fixing the movement jitter bug we created another issue in Vehicle Passengers that we are resolving by moving to a slightly different model including turret gunners for Tanks and passive sitters for Jeeps. (You can take a look at the Tank turret gunners in the promo video!)

We are looking good for releasing the big new map, these changes and bug fixes next week on Fri 5 Jul 24.
